scope.audience: UAE paid social automotive audience; exact cohorts and cross-placement comparability not independently reconciled
scope.vehicle_context: Mixed current used-car inventory; WhatsApp buyers often search for different models or a maximum AED budget rather than only the advertised car

learning: User-forwarded Meta retrospective reported Reels 378.11 AED/115 Meta-initiated conversations versus Feed carousel 136.38 AED/8, and qualitative WhatsApp evidence of inventory-finding intent. Investigate a Reels-to-inventory-shortlist-to-appointment funnel, with faster replies and authoritative Sheet-based 2–3 car recommendations. Treat platform messaging volume as diagnostic until joined to received messages, qualified leads, appointments and sales. Do not extrapolate Meta conversation rates to Google Search.
reusable_conditions: Initial Meta Reels lead-creative planning with a clear WhatsApp inventory-finding CTA and current showroom inventory.
Sales qualification workflow: desired model/body type, budget, confirmed CASH ONLY suitability, matching available options, concrete showroom time.
Google Search exploratory strategy only as a qualitative intent hypothesis; validate with independent Search query/account evidence.
invalid_conditions: Using conversation price as verified cost per qualified lead, appointment or sale.
Claiming causal Reels superiority to Feed without matching cohorts, times, offers and delivery conditions.
Treating reported spend or ad transitions as fully reconciled with the live Meta account without a dated API export.
Offering financing, warranty, discounts, availability or condition from old ads instead of authoritative business sources.
Applying observed Meta click-to-chat ratios as a Google Search forecast.
